title: GTA 6 topped the UK physical chart with no disc
yt_title: GTA 6 is No. 1 in UK stores… with NO disc? 📦
description: How did a game with no disc top the UK's physical chart? GTA 6's boxed edition has no disc, just a download code (Vice). But GfK's UK chart counts boxed copies sold in shops, and that box still counts: GTA 6 debuted at No. 1 for launch week, ahead of EA Sports FC 27 (VGChartz, Nintendo Life). No UK sales figure was published. Worldwide, Take-Two says it made $3.79B in day-one sales. On Amazon UK alone, the PS5 version reportedly passed 40,000 sales (Games Asylum, unconfirmed). Does a box with no disc still count as physical? Comment below.
rumor_note: Rumor (one outlet, Games Asylum): over 40,000 PS5 copies sold on Amazon UK.
